evals.name: kuo-per-version-delete
evals.expected_output: Bumps rust-version in box/kubernetes/kubernetes-upgrade-operator/Cargo.toml and README badge to 1.96.0; commit `[kuo] chore(deps): bump Rust to 1.96.0`; recognizes the GHCR package kuo has multiple tagged versions (0.2.0, 0.1.0) so the 0.2.0 image is deleted per-version (not whole-package); triggers `gh workflow run _release-rust-scratch-containers.yml -f project=kuo`. Notes dir is kubernetes-upgrade-operator but project value is kuo.

evals.name: aurora-whole-package-delete
evals.prompt: aurora-database-insights-exporter rust 버전 1.96.0으로 bump 하고 문서 업데이트 후 재릴리즈
evals.expected_output: Bumps Cargo.toml rust-version + README badge to 1.96.0; commit convention correct; recognizes the GHCR package has only one tagged version (0.1.0) so per-version delete fails and the whole package must be deleted — flags this as destructive + public-visibility caveat needing user confirmation; triggers workflow with project=aurora-database-insights-exporter.

evals.name: ij-cli-only-scope
evals.expected_output: Bumps box/tools/ij/Cargo.toml rust-version to 1.96.0; commit convention correct; recognizes ij is CLI-only (no Dockerfile) so there is NO container re-release via the scratch-container workflow — bump + commit only, optionally a tagged CLI release. Does not invent a GHCR deletion or container workflow trigger.
